review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous category-theoretic framework connecting topological invariants to dynamical constraints across different physical domains. Specifically: (1) A functor from the category of topological spaces with dynamics to a category of constrained observables, (2) A stability theory for topological invariants under perturbations in the space of flows, (3) A unified treatment of 'robustness' that applies to both quantum correlations and acoustic edge modes.
